intitule: Create Affirmative and Negative Sentences - Describe Your Class

enonce.texte: Instructions: Write 5 sentences about your English class. Use the verb 'to be' in the affirmative and negative forms. Include information about the teacher, the students, and the classroom.

questions.texte: Write 5 sentences about your English class using 'to be'.
questions.reponse: Example: The teacher is kind. The students are motivated. The classroom is not big. The lessons are interesting. I am happy to be here.

enonce.texte: Instructions: Write a short paragraph (5-7 sentences) describing yourself and a friend. Use the verb 'to be' with different subjects (I, my friend, we, etc.). Include affirmative, negative, and interrogative forms.

questions.texte: Write a paragraph describing yourself and a friend using 'to be'.
questions.reponse: Example: I am a student. My friend is from Douala. We are classmates. The school is not far from our homes. We are happy to study together. Is your friend also a student? Yes, he is.

intitule: Interview a Classmate - Ask Questions with 'To Be'

enonce.texte:
Instructions: Interview a classmate. Ask questions using the verb 'to be'. Write the questions and their answers.

Example questions:

  • Are you from Cameroon?
  • Is your family large?
  • Are you a student?
  • Is English easy for you?
  • Are we in the same class?

questions.texte: Write 5 questions and answers from your interview.
questions.reponse: Example: Q: Are you from Cameroon? A: Yes, I am. Q: Is your family large? A: No, it isn't. Q: Are you a student? A: Yes, I am. Q: Is English easy for you? A: No, it isn't. Q: Are we in the same class? A: Yes, we are.

intitule: Fill in the Blanks - 'To Be' in Context

enonce.texte:
Instructions: Complete the text with the correct form of 'to be' (am, is, are, am not, isn't, aren't).

My name ______ Marie. I ______ from Yaoundé. I ______ a student. My school ______ in the city centre. My teacher ______ very kind. The students ______ very friendly. We ______ in the same class. English ______ difficult for me, but it ______ interesting. My friends ______ from different regions. We ______ all happy to learn.

questions.texte: Complete the text with the correct form of 'to be'.
questions.reponse: My name is Marie. I am from Yaoundé. I am a student. My school is in the city centre. My teacher is very kind. The students are very friendly. We are in the same class. English is not difficult for me, but it is interesting. My friends are from different regions. We are all happy to learn.

intitule: Create a Dialogue - Introduce Yourself and Others

enonce.texte: Instructions: Create a dialogue between two people meeting for the first time. They should introduce themselves and ask questions about each other using the verb 'to be'. Include at least 8 exchanges.

questions.texte: Write a dialogue using 'to be' for introductions.
questions.reponse: Example: A: Hello! I am John. What is your name? B: Hi! My name is Sarah. A: Nice to meet you, Sarah. Are you from Cameroon? B: Yes, I am. I am from Buea. And you? A: I am from Yaoundé. Are you a student? B: Yes, I am a student at the University of Buea. A: That's great! I am also a student. Are we in the same class? B: No, we aren't. But we are friends now!
